answer:
The first person to hold the elevated office in British India was **Charles John Canning** (later 1 st Earl Canning).  

| Period | Title |
|--------|-------|
| 28 Feb 1856 – 31 Oct 1858 | **Governor‑General of India** (the role was newly elevated from that of “Governor”) |
| 1 Nov 1858 – 21 Mar 1862 | **Viceroy and Governor‑General of India** (after the Government of India Act 1858 the post was styled “Viceroy” in addition to “Governor‑General”) |

So, the **position** he held was:  
**Governor‑General of India** (and, from 1858 onward, also the Viceroy and Governor‑General of India).
